How should "high engagement" be defined? For example, is it CES >= some threshold (e.g., 0.7), or another rule?

In this task, "high engagement" is defined as having a Customer Engagement Score (CES) strictly greater than 0.7 (i.e., CES > 0.7). The CES itself is computed as a weighted combination: 0.4 × product usage score + 0.3 × channel usage score + 0.2 × bank relationship score + 0.1 × (customer service interactions / 10).
